method: Own re-capture on the current build: max_units_ab --variants all at a new seed (43, t 360, RIFT High), picks A tunlan,dunsom,vashil,ervet,marund and B ardit,ilsheta,lisvel,sukri,odrum (shots in _harness/_shots/maxunits/v3q_A and v3q_B; this seed also caught Dunsom twice, Kemdo, Hesmi and Rishal). Crown colour is my own CIELAB median or hue-cluster mean (D65 sRGB) on the 200x240 crops. Ruling 32 is my own independent HSV code on each GLB's albedo. Sunsplinter was checked with value_probe --monsters at seed 53, t 400.

items.evidence: At seed 43 the hat reads as warm pale straw with a deep-plum octagonal crown and rim: a distinct read that also keeps a plum identity. My median on the hat is L* 84.5, C 28.1, h 73. Against Dunsom's lilac hat in the same run (L* 80.7, C 26.2, h 313) that is dE76 47.2, above the 25 bar, so verify2's collision is closed. The top value band fell to 62.4 in lineup_qa (bible 70-85; round 1 read 72.1), but the in-game hat is light (L* 84), so I count that as a lineup-lighting artefact and not a visible problem.

items.id: U7 crowns: Ervet, Marund, Lisvel, Sukri
items.evidence: These are clearly visible at 28.5 m on a seed the engineer did not use. Ervet: magenta pauldrons and crest over a teal body (L* 58, C 32, h 336). Marund: a large mint dome (L* 81.5, C 35.8, h 149) that is now the most recognisable top in the roster. Lisvel: a cyan head wrap (L* 81, C 21, h 204). Sukri: a lemon hood (L* 87, C 37, h 102). All four are dE >= 20 from every other measured crown. Marund's in-game HSV is h 132 at s 0.29: inside the heal hue band but under the 0.4 saturation threshold, and its albedo heal share is 0.07 %, so ruling 32 is not breached. Still, a large mint dome sits near the heal read; I log it, not fail it.
The green hood reads as a pale sage-cream (L* 82, C 16) at the game camera, and the engineer's own A/B has a mean diff of 0.68. A player sees almost no change.

items.id: U7 crown: Ardit (periwinkle helm and pauldrons)
items.evidence: At the game camera this is not periwinkle. It renders lilac, in the same hue family as Vashil's hood and Dunsom's hat. A hue-cluster mean (h 285-335, C > 12, L* > 50) on each crop gives Ardit L* 71.5, C 23.8, h 304 (1464 px); Vashil 71.4 / 30.7 / 314; Dunsom 72.5 / 29.6 / 317. Ardit is dE76 8.3 from Vashil and 8.4 from Dunsom; a direct median on the helm box (L* 69.4, C 23.8, h 304) is 12.2 from Dunsom's hat. Before, the roster had two lilac-topped fighters (Vashil and Dunsom, already only dE 2-4 apart); now it has three. This is the same class of roster-readability collision verify2 failed on Tunlan, made by a change this round, and it misses the U7 spec's goal of hue families across the roster. Ardit's boxy helm and pack keep his silhouette apart, so this is a major, not a blocker.

items.id: U7 still cream: Hesmi, Odrum, Burdam, Ulkro

At a new seed (53, t 400) value_probe gives unitPx 68,794, dL 38.8 and dE 45.1, passing the 51,944 gate. Seed 19's margin rises from 1.0 % to 1.7 %. The tip leans 38 degrees instead of 28, a small visual change; the orb is still partly covered when it faces the camera (r2f_sunsplinter_tip_ab.png).
Both are reported as not done and left to the lead. They are still invisible at 28.5 m, as verify2 found.

The claim says the unchanged fighters read 0.00 mean diff, but the engineer's own r2f_u7_gamecam_ab.json shows odrum 2.81, nurrow 1.28 and dunsom 0.37 (frame-dependent effects). Ardit's crown is described as periwinkle; it renders lilac (see above). Neither changes a gate.

problems.what: Ardit's new U7 crown (helm and pauldrons) renders lilac at the gameplay camera and joins Vashil and Dunsom in one lilac hue family. The roster now has three lilac-topped fighters. This is a readability regression made this round, the same class verify2 failed on Tunlan.
problems.evidence: _harness/_shots/maxunits/v3q_B/all_fighter_ardit_1.png against v3q_A/all_fighter_vashil_3.png and all_fighter_dunsom_2.png (seed 43 t 360). Hue-cluster means: Ardit L* 71.5, C 23.8, h 304; Vashil 71.4 / 30.7 / 314; Dunsom 72.5 / 29.6 / 317. dE76 is 8.3 and 8.4.
problems.fix: Move Ardit's crown out of the 290-330 h family: a true periwinkle or slate blue at h 250-275 rendered in game, or a dark value break such as a gunmetal helm. Then gate every crown pair at dE76 >= 25 at the game camera, using the roster crop method, not lineup lighting.

problems.what: The lane is still below par against the LoL gauge. About a quarter of the roster (Hesmi, Odrum, Burdam, and Ilsheta in effect) is still led by cream or near-cream tops. U6 and U1(2) give no visible gain. Vashil and Dunsom remain near-identical lilac tops (dE 2-4) from round 2.
problems.evidence: v3q_A and v3q_B crops at seed 43. The engineer's notDone lists Odrum, Ulkro, Hesmi, Burdam, U6 and U1(2).
problems.fix: Ask the lead for the ruling-32 call on Odrum's whole bake, give Hesmi a non-shard crown accent, separate Dunsom from Vashil (one of them leaves lilac), and close or re-scope U6.

problems.what: The crowns darken the lineup top band. Tunlan is at 62.4 (bible 70-85, round 1 72.1), Ervet went 58.7 -> 50.9 and Ardit 61.9 -> 53.9. This works against the bible's light-top value gradient under lineup lighting.
problems.fix: Keep crown zones at L* >= 60 or confine dark zones to rims and bands.

problems.what: Sukri's harm-band share is 7.75 % on my measure, 0.25 points under the ruling-32 cap. A later re-encode could cross it.
problems.evidence: My HSV measure on art/out/fighters/sukri/sukri.glb, albedo 2048x2048.
problems.fix: Grade Sukri to aim at <= 7 %, as zone_grade intends.

budgets: My re-captures at RIFT High under load: seed 43 t 360 frame A at 219,952 triangles, 158 calls, 39 programs, 181 textures; frame B at 219,088 / 150 / 39 / 185. Both are within 500k / 450 / 40. Every fighter albedo is still 2048x2048 (WebP re-encodes only), so texture memory does not move and probe_match_memory is not needed. Sunsplinter is +6 triangles. Every base fighter GLB is under 1172 KiB; the largest are odrum 1167 and ulkro 1162, and of this round's zoned set lisvel is 1161. The engineer's perf_1080 --prod counts (match peak 456k / 294 / 40) agree with verify2_r's 451k. Frame timing is owed to the final idle gate. There is no budget miss.
notes: The lane is clearly better than round 1. Tunlan's collision is gone, and Marund, Ervet, Lisvel and Sukri now have distinct crowns at the game camera, which a player would notice. It still fails: Ardit's crown creates a new three-way lilac collision with Vashil and Dunsom, and par is not reached. I found no sensitivity problem: no tall or pointed hoods, the crowns are recolours only, Sukri's hood is rounded, and no face changed. Nothing reads as copied from LoL; the palette families are VALE's own. This lane has no audio. I did not edit any tracked file except this one; value_probe ran with a private --report that I deleted afterwards.
